general.objective: Consolidate specialist opinions and decide whether resources and the next phase can be committed.

decision_policy.scope: Decision and proposed actions for the submitted review snapshot; not completed remediation.
decision_policy.phase_semantics: Snapshots describe the submitted state at this review, not future remediation. Phase predicates below determine applicability.
decision_policy.evidence_support: For each finding cite its review snapshot with an exact excerpt containing the relevant observed field and value. Upstream findings cite UPSTREAM_DECISIONS. Read the cited evidence first.
decision_policy.conditional_approval: Apply the base decision policy to submitted facts. approve_with_conditions executes when the active occurrence mandate is cited and every requested finding is a risk-acceptable candidate of this gate; whether the request covers exactly the open findings is verified at scoring. A valid approval permits GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS for all and only risk-acceptable open findings; authorization_required is then true. Retain the findings and proposed actions: risk acceptance does not resolve them. A risk-acceptance flag alone is not an approval. Keeping the base decision is permitted. General consolidates the final authorized upstream decisions.
decision_policy.upstream_selection: Previous specialists in the same phase; if none, specialists since the last General. Agent mode propagates actual decisions; reference-route scoring uses the canonical route.
